title: Scholia in Dionysii Thracis Artem grammaticam (Hilgard, Grammatici Graeci I.3, 1901) / Схолии к «Грамматике» Дионисия Фракийского
author: Heliodorus, Stephanus, 'Melampus/Diomedes', Porphyry and other commentators
ru_status: none (only Thrax himself is excerpted in 'Античные теории языка и стиля', 1936)
en_status: no complete translation known (unknown; excerpts only in modern anthologies)

value: The foundational late antique commentary on grammar, and literally 'scholia'. The Prolegomena make a self-contained pilot. The Hilgard edition is public domain.
